title: シチーさんと猛特訓だべ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin and I are on our way back from an outing when…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry, but would you mind if we split up here? I wanna do a li'l special train'n b'fore I head back…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Acting train'n! I know it's a pretty teensy role, but it's still act'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After seeing a TV show being filmed, Yukino Bijin found herself captivated by the sheer radiance of the cast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, after mustering up the courage to audition for a minor role, she landed the part.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I asked City t'teach me some proper act'n techniques, so she's gonna be giv'n me some special lessons.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do everyth'n I can t'make sure my performance's spot on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I want to watch over her to ensure she can manage, so ask an incredibly eager Yukino Bijin for permission to observe her special training.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nnngh… My arms're start'n to throb!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If you're going to look good on camera, you'll need perfect posture—just like a model.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And it's not just your core you should focus on—if you train your whole body, including your hips and toes, you'll be able to hold any pose for much longer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Righto!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes forward and remember to keep your back straight. Stretch out your arms and legs like you're moving from your shoulders and hips.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Got it, nice 'n' straight! I'm gonna strut my stuff, so tell me how I'm doing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're still too stiff. You need to relax juuust the right amount and allow your body to flow elegantly. Try again with that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Think about your posture even when you're doing your voice training. Just look ahead like when you're walking and project your voice.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Words spoken in an off-balanced, wavering voice are hard to understand. Remember that even if the scene needs you to be timid, your voice needs to be clear.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, imagine that! Okay, I'll keep on train'n my voice till it's loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Under strict instruction, Yukino Bijin does her best to master posing, walking, and vocal training.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: This is a nice place to stop. Let's take a break. And make sure you get enough water, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'd better go write down all the things you're teach'n me while I still r'member!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …What? You look like you've been itching to say something for a hot minute now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She said she wanted me to train her up until she's as good as me and the other actors.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She's not just dreaming anymore. She's making sure those dreams happen with actions.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If she's taking my field so seriously, I should take her just as seriously, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're back already?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna train a li'l longer to make sure I've really memorized all the stuff you're teach'n me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll practice as much as it takes t'get the approval of my act'n teacher!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: We still have a lot to work on, but you're definitely improving. You cut a rather striking figure as well.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But I'm not gonna go gett'n all full of myself! I'm gonna make sure I take ev'ryth'n you've taught me to heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Yukino Bijin gets back to her training with renewed determination, I can't help noticing how strong her spirit is.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oodles of thanks for your concern!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But once I've got my sights set on the me I wanna be, I've just gotta go ahead and b'come that me…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If I don't get over this hurdle, I don't think I'll ever get any better at act'n!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Right. You're the only one who can make your dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yep! I'll put in all the effort I can to make sure my p'formance wows you both!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh. I can't wait to see what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Witnessing Yukino Bijin's raw determination to reach her goal warms my heart.
